description: R-PAR-1 PAR-FOLD, SQL-AGG-TYPE: For the Currency groups of FC, what does Avg return (type, value, or error and call) per group (WHERE g = 1 to 12, one statement each); and what do Min, Max and Count give as GROUP BY g? Runs on a fresh copy of r-par-1-fold2 opened read-only through DAO OpenDatabase in one process and one STA; each statement is opened with Database.OpenRecordset as a snapshot unless stated, and every call's result, HRESULT and DBEngine.Errors are captured.

args.text: SELECT Avg(c) AS a FROM FC WHERE g = 1
SELECT Avg(c) AS a FROM FC WHERE g = 2
SELECT Avg(c) AS a FROM FC WHERE g = 3
SELECT Avg(c) AS a FROM FC WHERE g = 4
SELECT Avg(c) AS a FROM FC WHERE g = 5
SELECT Avg(c) AS a FROM FC WHERE g = 6
SELECT Avg(c) AS a FROM FC WHERE g = 7
SELECT Avg(c) AS a FROM FC WHERE g = 8
SELECT Avg(c) AS a FROM FC WHERE g = 9
SELECT Avg(c) AS a FROM FC WHERE g = 10
SELECT Avg(c) AS a FROM FC WHERE g = 11
SELECT Avg(c) AS a FROM FC WHERE g = 12
SELECT g, Min(c) AS mn, Max(c) AS mx, Count(c) AS n FROM FC GROUP BY g
